## IE2eUser type

Simulated Telegram user for E2E updates.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IE2eUser = {
    id?: number;
    username?: string;
    first_name?: string;
    last_name?: string;
    language_code?: string;
    is_bot?: boolean;
};
```

## Remarks

Partial mirror of the Telegram Bot API User object. Any omitted field falls back to the helper default (`id` 1001, `first_name` `Test`<!-- -->, `is_bot` false, `language_code` `en`<!-- -->). Consumed by `E2eHelper._defaultUser`<!-- -->.
